Important Warning,
,"* Do NOT delete any rows.
* Do NOT cut and paste any cells. (Copy and paste is OK.)
* Do NOT move any cells.
* Only write in WHITE cells.

If you break any of these rules the spreadsheet will completely break. Don't even think about doing any of them."
Instructions,
1,"Make a copy of this file. (Select File, Make a Copy...)"
2,"In the copy, enter rider names in the ""Registration"" sheet in order of seeding. If there are less than 32 riders, enter dummy names and numbers to fill the blank spots (ensure there are no duplicate names or numbers)."
3,"Enter the results for each race in the ""Brackets"" sheet. Enter 1 for first, 2 for second etc. Also, 
* enter 5 for DNF (did not finish)
* enter 6 for DSQ (disqualified)
* enter 7 for DNS (did not start)"
